### Props

| Name          | Type                                  | Required | Default                | Description                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `nodes`       | `Array<object>`                       |          | `[]`                   | Nodes to render. Each entry: `{ id, label?, isRoot?, colour?, radius?, x?, y? }`. `x` / `y` are only honoured under `layout: 'manual'`.      |
| `edges`       | `Array<object>`                       |          | `[]`                   | Edges to render. Each entry: `{ id?, source, target, label?, colour?, dashed? }`. Edges referencing unknown node ids are silently dropped.   |
| `layout`      | `string`                              |          | `'radial'`             | Layout strategy: `radial` (default; root at centre + others on perimeter), `grid` (uniform grid), `manual` (consumer supplies x/y per node). |
| `size`        | `number`                              |          | `400`                  | SVG viewBox size (square).                                                                                                                   |
| `nodeRadius`  | `number`                              |          | `18`                   | Default node radius (px). Each node may override via its `radius`.                                                                           |
| `nodeColor`   | `string`                              |          | `'#0082c9'`            | Default non-root node colour.                                                                                                                |
| `rootColor`   | `string`                              |          | `'#21468b'`            | Root-node colour.                                                                                                                            |
| `edgeColor`   | `string`                              |          | `'#999'`               | Default edge colour.                                                                                                                         |
| `edgeWidth`   | `number`                              |          | `1.5`                  | Default edge stroke width.                                                                                                                   |
| `strokeColor` | `string`                              |          | `'#fff'`               | Node stroke colour.                                                                                                                          |
| `title`       | `string`                              |          | `''`                   | Optional title rendered above the SVG.                                                                                                       |
| `description` | `string`                              |          | `''`                   | Optional description rendered under the title.                                                                                               |
| `ariaLabel`   | `string`                              |          | `'Relationship graph'` | ARIA label for the SVG.                                                                                                                      |
| `legend`      | `Array<{label:string,colour:string}>` |          | `[]`                   | Legend entries — `{ label, colour }` pairs rendered as a key under the SVG. Empty array hides the legend.                                    |

### Events

| Name         | Payload | Description                                                                          |
| ------------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `node-click` | —       | Emitted on node click. Payload is the original node entry (without computed coords). |
